name: Fluxknight - Appointment Booking & Reminders - Multi Tenant v4

parameters.jsCode:
const env=$('Validate Appointment Envelope').first().json;
const rows=Array.isArray($json)?$json:[$json];
const snap=rows[0];
if(!snap) throw new Error('Runtime snapshot not found');

const schema={
  action:'book|reschedule|cancel|confirm|remind|complete|mark_no_show|request_information|handoff|skip',
  status:'requested|pending_availability|confirmed|rescheduled|cancelled|completed|no_show|needs_information',
  title:'string',
  appointment_type:'string',
  requested_start_at:'ISO datetime|null',
  requested_end_at:'ISO datetime|null',
  duration_minutes:'integer|null',
  timezone:'IANA timezone string',
  location_type:'virtual|physical|phone|unspecified',
  location:'string|null',
  attendee_name:'string|null',
  attendee_email:'string|null',
  attendee_phone:'string|null',
  notes:'string|null',
  reminder_offsets_minutes:['integer'],
  confirmation_message:'string|null',
  reminder_message:'string|null',
  cancellation_message:'string|null',
  missing_information:['string'],
  calendar_action_required:'boolean',
  notification_required:'boolean',
  handoff_required:'boolean',
  handoff_reason:'string|null',
  reason:'string',
  confidence:'0-1 number',
  memory_facts:[{type:'preference|appointment|availability|fact',summary:'string',confidence:'0-1'}]
};

return [{json:{
  ...env,
  execution_id:$('Queue Appointment Execution').first().json.execution_id,
  snapshot:snap,
  provider_request:{
    execution_id:$('Queue Appointment Execution').first().json.execution_id,
    organization_id:env.organization_id,
    agent_id:env.agent_id,
    instructions:snap.compiled_prompt+'\nUse only supplied tenant configuration, business hours, knowledge, memory, appointment details and approved tools. Never claim a booking, cancellation, reschedule or reminder was completed unless the action dispatcher confirms it. Interpret dates in the tenant or customer timezone. Return strict JSON only using this schema: '+JSON.stringify(schema),
    input:JSON.stringify({
      event_type:env.event_type,
      channel:env.channel,
      appointment_id:env.appointment_id,
      customer:env.input.customer||{},
      appointment:env.input.appointment||{},
      requested_slots:env.input.requested_slots||[],
      message:env.input.message||env.input.text||'',
      timezone:env.input.timezone||null,
      business_context:env.input.business_context||{}
    })
  }
}}];
